added 1 commit
  • abffaa8c - gtpv2: Dissect PSCell ID IE
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/15175/diffs?diff_id=974917426&start_sha=b50f985d5c611f42e31c0e8c81f3a6a34c95abe6)
I don't think this is needed.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/15175/diffs?diff_id=980879679&start_sha=abffaa8ced3e5e1e1414946402f669b4b8a6fff8#c98eae7adb877ff5751acbb4207fbd97c2f56260_17_17)

I think both the hf fields should be FT_UINT40 with a length of 5, then the mask should be
0xf0 0000 0000 for the spare bits and 0x0f ffff ffff for the nr cgi
Oh I understand. So you want to handle the 40 bits "together" and get the right value from them with bit masks. It is a very clever, I really like this approach. Thank you for suggesting this.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/15175/diffs?diff_id=980879679&start_sha=abffaa8ced3e5e1e1414946402f669b4b8a6fff8#c98eae7adb877ff5751acbb4207fbd97c2f56260_12662_12661)

Maybe base hex would be better:
The coding of the NR CGI is the responsibility of each administration. Coding using full hexadecimal representation (binary, not ASCII encoding) shall be used.

I will change this to `BASE_HEX`.
So when using `proto_tree_add_item` I should change the encoding from `ENC_BIG_ENDIAN` to `E164_ENC_BINARY`?

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/15175/diffs?diff_id=980879679&start_sha=abffaa8ced3e5e1e1414946402f669b4b8a6fff8#c98eae7adb877ff5751acbb4207fbd97c2f56260_12667_12666)
No the encoding is just bytes not a E164 number.
